text_block_list.text:
One day, I was to meet up with Mejiro 
Ardan, who was already out, to do some 
shopping. Upon arriving at the meeting 
spot...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wow... What a gorgeous girl. She really 
feels like a sheltered, high-class lady...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
She really does have an ethereal vibe to 
her. Seems totally unaccustomed to the 
world~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: No... sorry to keep you waiting.
No... sorry to make you wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I only just arrived a moment ago myself. 
Well then, shall we head off?

And so, Mejiro Ardan and I bought the 
necessary supplies for training. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
――We finished earlier than scheduled, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Since we're already here, would you 
like to take the long way home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We've been talking business all day, so 
why don't we have a more casual chat?

And so, as we kept walking and picking 
random paths along the way—
choice_data_list:
(Looks like I wandered into somewhere 
sketchy...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This area has... quite a unique 
atmosphere.

Mejiro Ardan looked around the dim 
alleyway with curious, wandering eyes.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
She really does have an ethereal vibe to 
her. Seems totally unaccustomed to the 
world~.

"...Perhaps she's feeling uneasy in an 
unfamiliar place. Filled with the urge to 
protect her—"
choice_data_list: I'll protect you no matter what!

text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps she's feeling uneasy in an 
unfamiliar place. Filled with the urge to 
protect her—"
choice_data_list: I'll protect you no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I look forward to working with 
you.

To keep her from feeling any more uneasy, 
I chose the brightest streets possible—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, this street is...
choice_data_list: We managed to come out somewhere familiar!
We managed to come out somewhere familiar!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because a dependable knight protected me.

Come to think of it, I got caught up in 
the mood and said something like that... 
Feeling embarrassed after the fact—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ! Look out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Are you okay?

Moving in a rush made me lose my balance, 
and just as I was about to fall, Mejiro 
Ardan supported me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It was just, sort of 
adorable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's no need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because I, too, wish to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

I grab Mejiro Ardan's hand and start 
running. Let's break through all at once 
and get out of here—
Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, perhaps "this one"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Take my hand. Please follow me.

Just as I felt my arm grabbed, the lead 
shifted, and this time I was being pulled 
along by her...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm not familiar with this 
area... I think it would be best to head 
back the way we came.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to keep it down to a light 
jog, as much as possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Let's rest for a bit before 
heading back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Did she change her lead leg...? Could it 
be? Because—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you are to run, then escorting you must 
be my duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... it might be improper of me, but 
I found myself... enjoying that situation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind... I'd like to take the 
long way around again. I will escort you 
next time as well.
